Red Snapper Mini $149 Add to Cart This is the mini version of the Red Snapper, because pedal board space is the most expensive real estate on earth.  This tiny little guy is the same circuit as the original 3 knob Red Snapper with the addition of a couple of treble cut switches inside.  With the switches in the off position it is exactly the same circuit as the 3 knob Snapper.  Full sized through hole parts are used throughout,  no surface mount in here.  The Red Snapper mini will be sold direct from Menatone only, which accounts for the amazing price.  Just like every other Menatone pedal,  each one is made by hand, one at a time in the USA Dimensions are 1.5" x 3.66" Power supply must be used,  no battery for the mini. Build time approx. 2-5 weeks. The Red Snapper Mini fits Menatone's four-knob Red Snapper overdrive into a compact mini enclosure while keeping full-size through-hole components inside. It carries the Red Snapper's touch-sensitive, transparent voice with Volume, Tone, a Gain control Menatone calls Bite, and a hi-cut to roll off top end. Because of the tight layout it runs on an external power supply only, with no room for a battery. It delivers the same amp-preserving overdrive as the full-size version in a footprint that saves pedalboard space, hand-built in the USA. Ewing / LENARD Re-Inventions View my complete profile Thursday, August 31, 2023 OVERDRIVE- MENATONE Red Snapper mini ... same 1996 pedal in a mini box MENATONE RED SNAPPER mini  $140.00 USD Brian Mena started his business in 1996 with this pedal and is still making it.   He has a B size version with an added cut for the highs which for me is not needed. The circuit and parts has remained the same. Every pedal is still handmade by Brian.   He is world wide known for his other business. Hand made tobacco pipes, LOL. Brian works to live but does nit live to work. He enjoys what he does.   He keeps it simple. He does not do any marketing and simply makes a pedal after you order and shi ps it out. it can take up to 3 weeks. The RS is low gain to medium crunch pedal. it has a fabulous organic rich sound. At its lowest gain it is one the sweetest crisp sounding Boost pedals on the planet. Pushed hard it is fat, chunky and has incredible balz. CONCLUSION   It started by using the Tube Screamers topography   but has no comparison. It  has no buffers and no compression even the tone control was tossed.   It was the first and completely transparent OD.    You Love   it or you move on.     NOTE: You can go to the site for audio samples but Brian does not dumb down a pedal to fit a box.  It is hand wired through hole build.    The original was 3 knobs in a very large enclosure. This does indeed sounds like the 1996 original.                                                                                              @ 38:49 Posted by Paul L.
